slides.body: Monday, Oct. 5 at 7:30 p.m. at Kaseya Center in Miami. Tickets are $51 to $336. The show brings the Burning Up Tour All Over Again to downtown Miami.

slides.body: Tuesday, Oct. 6 at 6:30 p.m. at Kaseya Center in Miami. Tickets cost $10, and proceeds benefit cancer care and research at Baptist Health Herbert Wertheim Cancer Institute.

slides.headline: Infinity Song at Revolution Live
slides.body: Wednesday, Oct. 7 at 7 p.m. at Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. Tickets cost $40. The sibling band brings its harmony-heavy set and viral hit, Hater's Anthem.

slides.body: Thursday, Oct. 8 at 7 p.m. at Pinecrest Gardens in Pinecrest. Tickets cost $10. City Theatre stages four short plays in one hour, with live music from Hola Hi.

slides.body: Friday, Oct. 9 at 7 p.m. at the Adrienne Arsht Center in Miami. Tickets are $40.02. The set is billed as an evening of songs and stories tied to her new memoir, Bread of Angels.
